createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

enablecollapsiblegroups.description: Enable to allow sitemap groups to be collapsed.

isappaware.description: Information about whether the site map is associated with app module.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

showhome.description: Enable to show the home button in the sitemap.

showpinned.description: Enable to show the pinned dropdown in the sitemap.

showrecents.description: Enable to show the recents dropdown in the sitemap.
